build: Single-file HTML app (~3100 lines), no build step
conventions: Anthropic brand colors (#141413, #faf9f5, #d97757, #6a9bcc, #788c5d). ≥18px fonts. Full-width layout. Per-section category tabs (物理/历史). Landscape A4 print with page-break-before per section.
structure: exam-analysis.html (single file, ~3094 lines). 7 analysis sections + overview: overview, cutoff-comparison, top-student-ranking, top-student-tiered-avg, top-pct-avg, elite-distribution, subject-contribution. JS core: computeResult() parses data, render*() functions create HTML+charts, exportPDF() uses JSZip + offscreen Canvas.

notes.batch_lines: 4 lines: 超一流/600分/双一流/一本线. Total + per-subject cutoffs. Edit table in UI.
notes.school_limit: 5-6 schools (SCHOOL_COLORS palette has 9 colors but practical limit due to readability).
notes.categories: 物理 + 历史 only, per-section tabs (independent switches).
notes.data_format: Raw student records (one row per student), not pivot tables. Expected columns: 学校, 科类, 各科分数, 总分.
notes.demo_data: 5 schools, 物理/历史 split, random elective choices, injected elite students for 超一流/600分 data.
notes.export: JSZip-based ZIP export. Creates offscreen canvases for all categories/sub-tabs, renders charts via Chart.js, captures via toDataURL(), draws tables on canvas via drawTableOnCanvas(). Output folder structure by category.
